sanskrit_verse: यः स्वामिना नियुक्तस् तु धनायस्यापलापने । कुसीदकृषिवाणिज्ये निसृष्टार्थस् तु स स्मृतः ॥
transliteration: yaḥ svāminā niyuktaḥ tu dhanāyasyāpalāpane | kusīdakṛṣivāṇijye nisṛṣṭārthaḥ tu sa smṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who is appointed by the owner for safeguarding wealth, yet fails in that duty through negligence or misconduct, especially when engaged in unproductive agriculture or trade, is declared as having lost purpose and direction.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from conscious assignment by rightful ownership
Causation arises from failure to uphold assigned capacity
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with productive intent
Restoration logic demands reorientation toward dharmic productivity
Consciousness alignment occurs through reaffirming one's role within cosmic order
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A is assigned stewardship of asset X BY owner O, THEN A MUST maintain productive engagement with X ELSE A IS classified as misaligned
IF steward A demonstrates persistent idleness OR engages in non-productive activity REGARDING assigned asset X, THEN A MUST undergo realignment process
IF steward A fails to restore productive use AFTER realignment protocol, THEN ownership rights MAY be reassigned BY original owner O
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in the conscious acceptance of stewardship. Where a party entrusted with national or institutional assets demonstrates willful neglect or engages in activities devoid of dharmic productivity, the court must invoke restoration protocols rather than punitive measures, ensuring alignment with foundational dharmic purpose.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality stems from deviation from assigned capacity. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that lack of productive engagement leads to spiritual and material disarray. Responsibility is proportional to the level of conscious assignment. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction arises through conscious reintegration, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein the individual acknowledges their lapse in stewardship
Assign structured re-engagement plan focused on dharmically productive activity aligned with their capacity
Implement integrity reintegration sessions under guidance of qualified Dharma advisors
Reaffirm connection between personal duty and universal harmony through experiential learning modules
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores balance through consciousness-aligned action. There is no punishment—only realignment. Dharma prevails. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
